1287.author: yuanzhou75
1287.body:
Closes #1276

Idea Tree's template, intensity, depth, nodes and scoring direction could only be set for the whole deployment. This gives them a Session scope and a door in the composer.

## What it does

- **Layer merge** — `RuntimeSettingsOverrides.ideaTreeOverride` carries a partial of the five fields the catalog exposes. `resolveSettingsLayers` merges it per sub-field across global → project → session, so a Session that lowers `maxDepth` keeps the global template, and `resolveIdeaTreeSettings(sessionId)` returns the effective value — the global object unchanged when nothing overrides it.
- **A research reads it when it is created** — `createIdeaResearchClient` composes a research's settings from `resolveIdeaTreeSettings(sessionId)`, so a change applies to the next research started in that conversation and never to one already running. The run snapshot deliberately does **not** freeze this value: `executeAgentRun` clears `ideaTreeSettings` on that path, so a frozen copy would only record a promise nothing reads.
- **Contract** — `settings-catalog` lists `system` and `session` for `idea_tree`; `UpdateSessionRequest.ideaTreeOverride` is the write path; the strict allow-list rejects a field it does not know, and only the five fields remain (`maxTokensPerCall` left with #1281).
- **Desktop** — `会话设置` gains an `idea-tree` row under 程序演进实验 which opens a parameters card. The card is drawn with the same `Group`/`Row`/`Select` the Idea Tree settings page uses, and offers `只用于本次会话` (Session override) and `覆盖全局设置` (global write); cancel writes nothing; with no conversation the Session write is refused and the card says why.
- **Stale comment** — the landing test no longer claims 权限模式 lives in 会话设置.

## Screenshots

**These are component-level renders, not a full application journey.** The real `Composer` (with 会话设置 held open) and the real `IdeaTreeOverrideDialog` were mounted through the repo's own Vite dev server and captured in headless Edge. No hand-written markup, no mock-up; what you see are the shipped components and the shipped stylesheets. The Electron window cannot be automated in this environment.

Two real commits: **before `5783fded`** (this PR's base on main) and **after `85f95262`** (this PR's head). Same viewport per pair, same language.

The menu, Chinese — before: 程序演进实验 / 专家; after: 程序演进实验 / **idea-tree** / 专家.

![before, zh: no idea-tree row](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/25f76ccabee32b54838537222e67a99c0e223ac3/shots/1276/before-menu-zh.png)

![after, zh: idea-tree row between the evolve entry and 专家](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/25f76ccabee32b54838537222e67a99c0e223ac3/shots/1276/after-menu-zh.png)

The card, Chinese — the five fields at the global values, with the two writes:

![card, zh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/b956e3101e84d5fb78411f1fbbf39ebb8ed4a942/shots/1276/card-zh.png)

The same pair in English:

![before, en: no idea-tree row](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/25f76ccabee32b54838537222e67a99c0e223ac3/shots/1276/before-menu-en.png)

![after, en](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/25f76ccabee32b54838537222e67a99c0e223ac3/shots/1276/after-menu-en.png)

![card, en](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/b956e3101e84d5fb78411f1fbbf39ebb8ed4a942/shots/1276/card-en.png)

The card was re-captured after a spacing pass: it borrowed the evolve dialog's body, which has no horizontal padding of its own, so every field ran to the frame edge. It now carries its own block — 28px side padding, one row per field with a hairline between them, left-aligned hint sentences, the actions outside the scrolling body and on one line at a 620px panel. The frames above are from `13004cc3`, the head that carries that change.

What the captures caught, and what was fixed because of them: the first cut of the card carried class names no stylesheet defines (`idea-tree-override-*`, `modal-actions`, `button-primary`), so it rendered as bare stacked fields — `bc953aff` moves it onto the settings page's own `Group`/`Row`/`Select` and the evolve dialog's action buttons. The English hint also embedded the Chinese button label; `85f95262` says it in English.

## Tests run

- `services/api`: `src/runs/index.test.ts` + `src/store/settings.test.ts` — **35 / 35**, including a new case that walks the whole promise: no override → the run freezes the global settings; an override wins for the fields it names while the rest keep inheriting; a later global change reaches the inherited fields and never the overridden one; a sibling Session in the same project does not see it.
- `apps/desktop`: full suite **1358 / 1358**, including `tests/idea-tree-override.test.tsx` (the card starts from the global values, offers the five fields, the Session write patches the Session and never PUTs the global settings, the global write does the reverse, cancel writes nothing) and the composer row assertions.
- Type checks: schema build, `services/api` `tsc --noEmit`, `apps/desktop` `tsc --noEmit`, root `tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit` — all clean.

## Review round 1 (all four findings verified in code and fixed)

1. **The override never reached a research.** It was frozen into the run snapshot and then discarded: `executeAgentRun` clears `ideaTreeSettings` unconditionally, and `research.ts` built `settings` from `getIdeaTreeSettings()`. Create now reads `resolveIdeaTreeSettings(sessionId)`, and the freeze is gone — keeping a value nothing reads only recorded a promise that did not hold. `services/api/src/idea-tree/research.test.ts` pins the payload that leaves for the engine; it fails on the old code (`maxDepth` 5 instead of 3).
2. **The card wrote all five fields and offered no way back.** It now sends only the fields that differ from what it loaded, and `跟随全局设置` clears the override with `PATCH ideaTreeOverride: null`. With nothing differing there is nothing to override, so it reports success without a write.
3. **Stale comments.** The `store.ts` block ending "there is no per-Session override" sat on `resolveIdeaTreeSettings`, which does exactly that, and `getIdeaTreeSettings` had lost its own; both now describe what they precede. The JiuwenSwarm banner comment is back above `jiuwen` in both dictionaries.
4. **The override was accepted at Global and Project scope**, though the catalog gives it to the Session alone; both layers now strip it on write.

Two more from the bot review: the card's number fields keep their last accepted value instead of holding `0` or `3.5` (which both write paths reject), and the docs now describe the scope in both languages.

## The HTTP-level case (added after review round 1)

`services/api/src/server.test.ts` now drives the real route rather than the store:

- `GET /api/sessions/:id/settings` before any write reports `sources.ideaTreeOverride` as `unset`;
- `PATCH /api/sessions/:id` with `{"ideaTreeOverride": {"maxDepth": 3}}` answers **200**, and the read-back reports the source as `session` with `overrides.ideaTreeOverride` exactly that object;
- `PATCH` with `{"ideaTreeOverride": null}` answers **200**, the read-back is `unset`, and the key is gone from `overrides` — the Session inherits again.

The body is flat because `UpdateSessionRequest`'s own members are the settings; that is what the desktop client sends. My first version of this case wrapped them in `settingsOverrides` and got a 500, which is how I found that the flat shape is the contract.

## Known gap

- None outstanding on the review's findings. `services/api/src/server.test.ts` as a whole does not complete cleanly **in this environment** (115/119, four unrelated cases about skills, a PDF upload and subagents fail locally); the same file passed in CI on `85f95262`, which already carried the code changes, so those four are local, not this PR. CI is the authority.

## Not run

- e2e journeys (`apps/desktop/e2e`, `test/`): no browser here; CI runs them.
- The full `services/api` suite as one glob stalls in `src/server.test.ts` locally (run alone, it passes). CI is the authority.

1288.author: zhaochen39
1288.body:
The CI gates were missing regression coverage for several multi-step UI and API workflows, and the release gate could fail while collecting its test plan after the unit tests had passed. This change adds coverage for those workflows and fixes the product behavior exposed by the new checks.

## Regression coverage and product fixes

- Adds regression cases for reconnecting to an in-flight Run, recovering from an unavailable Runner, denying shell execution without side effects, and exporting, importing, and continuing from a read-only research snapshot.
- Covers built-in and remote Runner detail navigation in the current Desktop runtime settings and checks that browsing the catalog preserves the project Runner selection. Browser tests wait for asynchronous MCP discovery. The change also validates environment-management and memory-query inputs and excludes mismatched memory-graph data from artifact provenance.

## CI and release gates

- Uses the same source scope for the test-evidence inventory and the changed-path check, including API and Runner source files. The inventory and L1 use the same content-based classification. L1 requires evidence for added behavioral modules and warns about unmapped declaration-only or re-export-only modules and existing unmapped paths. Merge queue runs check the queue candidate range. Fork force pushes compare against the common ancestor with upstream main. Other force pushes can recover the exact previous tip when it is absent from the checkout.
- Runs full Desktop UI-ST and mocked E2E on the merge candidate and in nightly and release gates. PRs run Desktop unit tests and the changed Desktop mocked specs. Changes to shared Desktop fixtures, support, or Playwright config select the full mocked suite. Changed Web specs feed the frozen mocked Playwright plan.
- Builds the release-wide plan from the same tagged collection as the individual slices, prepares Playwright discovery dependencies, and preserves both plans and collection logs in the UT artifact.

## Validation

The original head had the following fork CI results. [Fork push CI for `f4d121a47c93919b7315cd3e21590f9da4b85c09`](https://github.com/zhaochen39/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/44862001651) reported L1 4/4, UT 8,047/8,047, and ST 69/69 passed. In each slice the planned, executed, and passed counts matched.

The current candidate `006c691c` is a single commit on base `25b41659`. The prior UT run failed at `check:typecheck` because the Runner auth regression accessed properties on JSON typed as `unknown`. The test now validates the JSON shape before checking the Runner-specific 502 response. The workspace typecheck and targeted API regression passed on Linux. The [current PR workflow](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/44891989809) passed L1, UT (8,147/8,147), ST, the selected mocked browser checks, both binary builds, Docker, and `merge-gate`. CodeCheck also passed. L1 reports 9/9 changed source paths mapped. On `fd8ed2cc`, 44/44 targeted CI policy, source inventory, and test-evidence regressions passed on Linux.

## E2E user journeys

The previous-head fork CI passed all six selected Web UI-ST cases. On `321e8203`, the fork merge-profile Desktop job passed all 13 UI-ST and all 164 mocked E2E cases. Both reports reconciled against their collected plans. [Desktop evidence with plans, reports, and summaries](https://github.com/zhaochen39/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/44885876593/artifacts/14699209385)

The main-repository PR Desktop job also passed. The final test-only fix matches the memory settings PUT explicitly so a concurrent GET cannot be mistaken for the write. The specific regression passed five consecutive local repetitions. [PR Desktop check](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/44885879495/job/136791326092)

## Release

Release category: `release:fix`

Malformed API requests receive validation errors, and mismatched memory-graph data is excluded from artifact provenance. No configuration or data migration is required.

1288.title: fix(ci): close regression gaps and stabilize release test plans

1289.author: yuanzhou75
1289.body:
Closes #1277

A hand-typed `/idea-tree-team` used to leave immediately, so the research always ran on the deployment defaults. It now opens the same parameters card 会话设置 opens, and the command leaves once the card is confirmed.

Rebased onto `main` now that #1287 merged (`348b4db4`); the diff is only this change.

**The command is not intercepted.** `defersIdeaSend` is a UI gate; the confirmed pass sends the identical text, so the agent still receives `/idea-tree-team …`, runs its preparation and calls `create_idea_research`. The `awaitingIdea` bookkeeping and the panel that opens on the research that request creates are untouched — that is why the command must still travel as a message (`idea/command.ts:26-29`).

**A first command needs no Session.** In the states that genuinely have none — a launch that resumes nothing, a Project switch on the welcome page, and a deletion that removes the open conversation — the command does **not** stop at the card. (新建会话 is not one of them: `createOpenSession()` opens a Session immediately, so the card does open there.) `defersIdeaSend` only defers when there is a Session to write to (`App.tsx:947`: `&& state.detail?.id !== undefined`), so the message leaves as it always did and `send()` creates the Session on the way. Deferring there would have parked the command behind a confirm button whose Session half has nothing to write; that is the regression this PR fixes against its own first cut.

How it works:

- The composer honours an `onSend` that answers `false` by keeping the draft; a deferred Idea Tree send is exactly that answer, so the words stay in the box while the card is open.
- Confirming writes the Session override (the temporary parameters from #1276) and then sends the command. With nothing changed there is nothing to write, but the command still leaves — being confirmed is what lets it out, not the write.
- Dismissing the card sends nothing and puts the sentence back in the composer with no token attached; `SeededCommand.command` is therefore optional.
- `/idea-tree` and `/idea-tree-team` behave identically.

## Screenshots

**Component-level renders, not a full application journey.** The real `IdeaTreeOverrideDialog` was mounted through the repo's own Vite dev server — with `onConfirm` present, which is the state a waiting `/idea-tree-team` gives it — and captured in headless Edge. No hand-written markup; the components and stylesheets are the shipped ones. The Electron window cannot be automated in this environment.

Both frames are head `d4b2a4de`: the action reads **确认并发送** instead of 只用于本次会话, and `跟随全局设置` is disabled because this Session pins nothing.

![the card while an idea-tree command waits: 确认并发送](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/c365e6b3a40f92fcd7df0164a165fd6c449941f0/shots/1289/confirm-zh.png)

![same, English](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/c365e6b3a40f92fcd7df0164a165fd6c449941f0/shots/1289/confirm-en.png)

## Tests run

- `apps/desktop` full suite: **1387 / 1387** — includes `tests/idea-send-gate.test.ts` (the command defers, the confirmed pass does not, other drafts do not, `/idea-tree-teams` is not the command) and the card cases: confirming with a change writes then sends; confirming with nothing changed sends and writes nothing.
- Type checks: `apps/desktop` `tsc --noEmit`, root `tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit` — clean.

## Retry after a failed write

The Session action is disabled only when the *read* failed (`draft === undefined`). A failed write keeps it pressable, so a transient `PATCH` error can be retried; a case drives that (first `PATCH` throws, the button stays live, the second press retries).

## Not run

- e2e journeys (`apps/desktop/e2e`, `test/`): no browser here; CI runs them.

1290.body:
Closes #1251

Search Sessions, projects and artifacts from the sidebar, and narrow the list by scope, run activity, artifacts and time window — the two halves of #1251 the desktop client was missing.

**Stacked on #1250** (session archive). This branch is built on that branch's tip; the `#1250` files are not part of this PR's delta. Review only the files listed below.

## What this adds

- **`api/workbench.ts`** — `GET /api/search`, the route the sidebar's field calls.
- **`app/session-search.ts`** — keyboard order over the results (`flatResults`, `moveHit`), how a result is described (`searchDetail`), and the artifact a hit names, held until the panel can list it.
- **`app/session-filters.ts`** — the four independent narrowings (scope / only running / only with artifacts / time window) and `filterSessions`, applied client-side: the workspace is small enough that filtering is cheaper than a request.
- **`app/session-read-only.ts`** — one predicate for "this Session cannot be written to", merging the archived state with the imported-snapshot state. `App.tsx` asks it instead of testing `archivedAt` in three places.
- **`views/Sidebar.tsx`** — the search field (label, placeholder, empty and failure states, grouped results with an 已归档 badge), Ctrl/Cmd+K to focus it, ↑/↓/Enter/Escape over the hits, and the four filter chips above the list.
- **`app/use-workspace.ts`** — the debounced search with a ticket so an old answer cannot paint over a newer one, `openSearchResult`, and `setListFilters` / `listFilters`.
- **`text/zh.ts`, `text/en.ts`, `styles/design.css`** — the field, the chips, the groups, the badge.

Archiving itself (the archive/restore commands, the read-only banner, 设置 › 会话管理) belongs to #1250 and is not described here.

## What this does **not** claim

- The field searches names and titles, not message bodies; the route says so, and the placeholder repeats it rather than implying a full-text search.
- The four chips are client-side filters over the page the workspace already holds. 仅运行中 reads the run state the client has, not a server query.

## Verification

Run in WSL (Ubuntu, linux-amd64, Node v22.23.4) against this head's tree:

- `tsc -p apps/desktop --noEmit` — clean.
- `tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit` — clean (it does not cover `apps/desktop`; a regression check, not evidence for these files).
- Seven desktop suites together — `session-search`, `session-filters`, `session-read-only`, `sidebar`, `sidebar-extra`, `session-management`, `session-archive` — **53 tests / 53 pass**.

One assertion moved with this branch: `session-archive.test.tsx` proved the removed three-way state filter was gone by looking for the words 活跃 / 已归档 / 全部, and the list's own chip reads 全部项目, so 全部 matched a control that is not the removed one. It now asserts on the control itself (`side-filter-item` and the group's `aria-label`).

## Screenshots

**UI hold:** approving this PR needs the **code owner to look at these captures**. It is a UI change; a code-only approval is not enough.

Rendered from this head `124a1e7f`: the real desktop bundle (`vite build` in `apps/desktop`), served from the local API's own origin so `/api` is same-origin, driven by Playwright's Chromium at viewport 1440×940 with `deviceScaleFactor: 2`, one browser context per locale with `sciencediscovery-desktop:locale` set before the first paint. The stack is the API on `http://127.0.0.1:4310` — **legacy backend (`--no-jiuwenswarm`), repository-default data directory (`.sciencediscovery-data`, not isolated)**.

| | zh-CN | en |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **1. The sidebar as it opens** — the search field, then the four widenings | ![sidebar zh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/shots-1286-1290/docs/screenshots/1290/1290-zh-1-sidebar.png) | ![sidebar en](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/shots-1286-1290/docs/screenshots/1290/1290-en-1-sidebar.png) |
| **2. A query** — `probe`, three hits, the archived one carrying its 已归档 badge | ![search zh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/shots-1286-1290/docs/screenshots/1290/1290-zh-2-search.png) | ![search en](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/shots-1286-1290/docs/screenshots/1290/1290-en-2-search.png) |

1293.author: yuanzhou75
1293.body:
Idea Tree has a mocked browser journey but no dedicated real-model L4 journey. Add a quick research journey that starts from a session, checks a scored candidate and insight, and verifies the persisted result after a reload. The journey configures a session-scoped override instead of changing global settings, follows the newly created research by ID, and settles on any terminal status so a failed run reports its cause instead of burning the poll budget.

## What the current head changes

- **The terminal poll stops on any settled status.** The engine settles as `completed`, `paused` (budget reached), `ended` (stopped) or `interrupted` (a model call or JSON parse failed) — `services/evolve/src/sciencediscovery_evolve/vendor/idea_tree/research.py:622-631`. Only `completed` can grow a scored candidate, so the old poll waited out its whole cap on a run that could never reach it; it now succeeds on any terminal status, and the following assertion fails with the persisted `research.reason`.
- **The waits are sized from a measured run, not guessed** — see the table below. Two polls also carry a `message`, so a live model that answers without calling `create_idea_research`, or a research that never settles, names the expectation that failed.
- **The reload claim matches its assertion.** The step asserts that the public API still returns the same completed research after `page.reload()`; the name and E2E-META text no longer imply the rendered progress control is checked here, because the mocked journey covers that surface.
- **`.ci/README.md` real case counts** updated for the new identity: L4 19 → 20.

## Validation

Static layers, run on Linux/amd64 (WSL Ubuntu, Node v22.23.4) at this head and reproduced on a second checkout:

| Layer | Command | Exit | Result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| E2E metadata | `node test/check-e2e-meta.mjs` | 0 | 97 spec files, 0 errors |
| Collection | `playwright test --config .e2e/playwright.config.ts --list` | 0 | 257 tests in 97 files, including this case |
| Frozen plan | `node test/support/tagged/shared.mjs list --profile daily --slice e2e-real` | 0 | 22 entries; this case present with `tier:l4, model:real, isolation:global` |

**This file is not covered by any `tsc` configuration.** `tsconfig.tests.json` includes only `packages/*/src/**/*.test.ts(x)` and `services/*/src/**/*.test.ts(x)`, so `tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit` plus the root `typecheck` script check nothing under `test/`. There is no `test/tsconfig.json` and no other config that includes it; the file is compiled by Playwright's transform, which does not type-check. An earlier revision of this description listed "Types: clean" here, which was wrong for exactly that reason — it has been removed rather than reworded. Type safety for this spec therefore rests on collection plus the passing execution below, not on a compiler.

Local UT, ST and mocked E2E are **not** claimed here: the Windows host cannot execute the suite's postinstall (`ln -sfn`/pnpm spawn). PR CI covers those layers, and on this head `L1`, `ST`, `UT`, `Coverage`, both binaries, `Docker image`, `CodeCheck` and `Select CI policy` are green with `merge-gate` success. `L3`/`L4/L5` are skipped on pull requests by policy.


## Real L4 execution — passed once, failed once

Two runs on the same head `a5f028cdad2a0a473b3c926704fc84f373f10d4f`. **This is not a stable pass: 1 of 2.**

| Run | Result | Detail |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **passed** | `playwright_exit=0`, `1 passed (8.2m)`, planned/passed/failed/skipped = 1/1/0/0, wall-clock 505s including a 15s stack start |
| 2 | **failed** | timed out in step 1 on `getByRole('region', { name: 'Idea Tree 研究控制' })` — `Timeout: 180000ms exceeded`, `element(s) not found`; case body 3.2 min |

Plan identity (`daily` / `e2e-real`, 22 entries):
`playwright:test/journey-idea-tree-real.spec.ts::real/journey-idea-tree-real.spec.ts/Idea%20Tree%20real%20research/real%20Idea%20Tree%20research%20completes%20and%20its%20result%20survives%20a%20reload`

Tags: `arch:amd64, category:e2e, fixture:standard, isolation:global, judge:none, model:real, npu:none, os:linux, sandbox:bubblewrap, status:reviewed, swarm:none, tier:l4`

**Where run 2 failed, and where it did not.** The failure is in the **agent preparation stage, before any research exists**. The transcript shows four rounds of the model exploring instead of calling the tool: `已探索 …` → `已调用 list_files` ("Writable workspace is empty") → an attempt at `$SCIENCEDISCOVERY_SKILLS_DIR/structure-pocket-inspection` → `调用失败: run_shell` (`mkdir -p /workspace/idea_tree && cat …`) → `Run stopped / Run cancelled`. In run 1 the same model called `create_idea_research` after 72s.

The `run_shell` line is a **consequence of the cancellation, not a sandbox defect**: the same command (`mkdir -p /workspace/idea_tree && echo ok && ls -la /workspace`) run standalone in a fresh session returns `status=succeeded`, exit 0, prints `ok`, and creates the directory. The selector is not the cause either — run 1 used the identical selector successfully.

**So the instability is behavioural and intermittent**: sometimes the model starts the research within seconds, sometimes it spends the whole budget exploring skill directories and never calls `create_idea_research` before the 180s card wait expires. Whether that is a prompt problem, a model-variance problem, or a product problem is **not yet established**, and this description does not claim otherwise.

**Environment, stated precisely.** WSL Ubuntu / linux-amd64; stack on `http://127.0.0.1:4310` — **the default port, and not an isolated data directory**: `start-stack --mode local` reads the repository `.env`, which overrides an exported `SCIENCE_DISCOVERY_DATA_DIR`, so the run used the repository-default data directory `.sciencediscovery-data`. Real runner and bubblewrap 0.9.0 (`bwrap --ro-bind / / --dev /dev true` passes). Model `http://113.46.219.251:8080/v1` with `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017`. **Backend `legacy`** (`start-stack.sh --no-jiuwenswarm`, because this checkout fails the jiuwenswarm patch check) while the daily profile defaults to `jiuwenswarm` (`ci.yml:121`).

## Measured runtime (same prompt through the runs API, no browser)

**These numbers come from the same path the case depends on, not from pre-creating a research.** The measurement sent `POST /api/sessions/:id/runs` with the same `/idea-tree Skip literature retrieval. Explore low-cost iron catalysts…` content the composer sends, and the research was created by the **agent calling `create_idea_research` on its own** — it appeared in `GET …/idea-tree/research` 72s later, with that run ending `completed`.

So it covers "the model starts the research from the prompt itself", which is the step the case is really about. What it does **not** cover is the composer's own UI/SSE leg; that is covered by the passing run listed above, which filled `form.composer` and clicked `运行分析`.

| Observation | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Research appears (agent called the tool) | 72s |
| Research reaches `completed` | 512s |
| Appearance → completion | ≈440s |
| Shape of the run | 4 candidates, 4 assessments, 2 rounds, 271,367 tokens |

```
180s  card region visible        (measured 72s; a 120s window missed once on a cold start)
180s  exactly one new research   (same measurement, same headroom)
720s  terminal status poll       (~60% headroom over the measured 440s)
────  1080s of internal waits inside a 1500s case budget, leaving ~420s
      for the composer command, the reload, the second read and cleanup
```

**Token cost, with its provenance.** The passing run's own ledger is unrecoverable: the case's `finally` calls `cleanupJourney`, which deletes the Project and with it the research record. The 271,367 figure is the runs-API measurement above — same prompt, same settings, same model, no browser — and should be read as the expected cost of this journey, not as the passing run's ledger entry.


## E2E user journeys

**PASSED once, FAILED once on the same head.** Planned: 1, passed: 1, failed: 1 across two attempts (pass rate 1/2). Attempt 1 passed in 8.2 min; attempt 2 never started a research — the agent spent the 180s card budget exploring skill directories instead of calling `create_idea_research`, so the case failed before the journey's own assertions ran. Selectors and sandbox were ruled out (same selector passed in attempt 1; the same `mkdir` command succeeds standalone).

## Known coverage gaps

1. **Backend.** The runs used `legacy`; the daily profile defaults to `jiuwenswarm`. Whether `jiuwenswarm` passes is not covered by this evidence.
2. **Stability — tracked separately in #1311.** The two runs on this head gave 1 pass and 1 failure, and the failure is in the agent's preparation stage rather than in this file: the model sometimes explores the workspace and skill directories for several rounds instead of calling `create_idea_research`, so no research exists when the card wait expires. That behaviour is filed as #1311 with the transcript, the two ruled-out causes (sandbox, selector) and the environment. It is a product-side question about tool selection, not something this test file can fix, so this PR is not blocked on it; the case is simply not yet a dependable gate until #1311 is resolved or the pass rate is measured over more runs.


## Release

Release category: release:internal
User impact: test coverage only.
Compatibility and migration: none.

1294.body:
﻿﻿## What changed

Folding the task column in the desktop client was component state only (`useState(true)` in `App.tsx`), and nothing read a stored value at startup. The workspace panel on the right already persists its own state, so the two panes disagreed: the reader who folded the left column to get the width back had to fold it again after every refresh.

- `apps/desktop/src/state/storage.ts`: new `SIDEBAR_STORAGE_KEY` (`sciencediscovery-desktop:sidebar`) beside the right panel's key, and `readStoredFlagOnByDefault` — only an explicit `"0"` means folded, so a first run, a cleared store, or a storage that refuses to answer still opens the column.
- `apps/desktop/src/App.tsx`: `sidebarOpen` initialises from that key and a `useEffect` writes it on every fold or expand, the same shape as the panel's persistence on the line above.
- The panel taking the column stays a transient: `taskSidebar = sidebarOpen && !panelOpen` is untouched, so the stored preference keeps what the reader chose rather than what the panel did for a moment.

## Verification

**Real browser, 1600x1000, zh-CN, mocked API, same entry and steps for both sides** (open, fold with 收起侧栏, then F5):

| | main area after fold | main area after F5 | sidebar after F5 | stored key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| before (`bbdbdd5c`) | 1530 px (from 1234 px) | 1234 px | shown again | `null` |
| after (this branch) | 1530 px | 1530 px | still folded | `"0"` |

**Regression test** — `apps/desktop/tests/app-model-setup-render.ts` grew a `sidebar-collapsed` scenario: it seeds `"0"`, renders `App`, asserts the shell carries `sidebar-hidden`, presses the page-head toggle (asserting the key becomes `"1"`), folds again (`"0"`), unmounts and renders a fresh `App` — the refresh path — and asserts the column is still folded.

Red first: with only the test harness in place and `App.tsx` left at `useState(true)`, the scenario fails in both languages with `a stored collapse must survive the first render` (2 failed, 0 passed). With the change it passes in both languages.

A mocked browser case (`apps/desktop/e2e/shell-interactions.spec.ts`) drives the same fold-and-reload in a real browser with the shared mocked API. That desktop suite is a local gate on this base — no workflow runs it — so it was executed by hand on this head: `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=$HOME/.cache/ms-playwright apps/desktop/e2e/node_modules/.bin/playwright test --config apps/desktop/e2e/playwright.config.ts shell-interactions.spec.ts -g "still folded"` → 2 passed (11.1s), including `a folded sidebar is still folded after a reload`.

**Local gates**

- `pnpm ci:l1` — PASS, 4 planned / 4 executed / 4 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop test` — 1398 tests, 1398 pass, 0 fail.
- `pnpm ci:ut` — the slice ran all 714 selected cases locally (run log reports 714/714 done), but the layer never writes its `summary.json`: a leftover `scripts/with-jiuwenswarm.sh … swarm.mjs hold` child keeps waiting for a real JiuwenSwarm instance, which this host does not provision. Recorded as an environment block, not a product failure; the machine-readable summary is missing, so this is not claimed as a pass.
- `pnpm ci:st` — not run locally yet: it needs the same service stack. GitHub CI runs UT and ST on this head.
- GitHub CI on `b61a92b1` (the later `81f794d9` only rewords a comment; the run on it is in progress): L1 **pass**, UT **pass** (10m05s), ST **pass** (4m56s), merge-gate **pass**, CodeCheck **pass**.
- `ci:e2e:real` — not run locally: no `E2E_LLM_BASE_URL` / `E2E_LLM_MODEL` / `E2E_LLM_TOKEN` and no spend approval on this machine.

## Screenshots

Both 1600x1000, zh-CN, mocked API, same entry and steps: open the task page, press 收起侧栏, then F5.

Fixes #1291

![Before (bbdbdd5c): after F5 the task column is back](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/275c88c3-52f1-4e36-adcb-051236621596)

![After (b61a92b1): after F5 the task column is still folded](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b74c4cbd-83d9-49d9-87b8-00dcb3ae144f)

## What changed and why

Starting a run on a model with no saved API key stopped immediately, but the failure had no machine-readable reason: the API threw a plain 400 and the classifier fell back to `semantic-error`, so the desktop card showed a generic English body instead of naming the missing key or the way out. This gives that failure its own stable code and localized copy.

- `packages/schema`: `RunFailureCode` gains `model-credential-missing`.
- `services/api/src/runs/index.ts`: the missing-token check now throws `ApiStatusError(400, "The selected model does not have a saved API token", "model-credential-missing")`. The original sentence is unchanged, so it still appears verbatim in 技术详情.
- `services/api/src/run-failure.ts`: classifies by the typed code next to `SESSION_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE`, not by matching English prose.
- `apps/desktop/src/text/zh.ts` / `en.ts`: title and body for the new code — zh “模型还没有配置 API Key” / “这个模型在设置里没有保存 API Key，运行无法开始。到 设置 › 模型 补上后重试。”, en “Model has no API key” / “This model has no saved API key, so the run cannot start. Add one in Settings › Models and try again.”
- `apps/web`: exhaustive `Record<RunFailureCode, MessageKey>` entry plus en/zh-CN messages, so the web client keeps typechecking and renders the same guidance.
- `RunFailureCard.tsx` is unchanged: the localized summary renders above the collapsed 技术详情, where the raw code and provider message stay.

## Validation

- `pnpm build` + `pnpm typecheck`: pass (all packages, including `@sciencediscovery/web` and `services/api`).
- `services/api/src/run-failure.test.ts`: 6/6 pass, including a new case proving the class comes from the typed code, not the sentence.
- `apps/desktop` suite: 1397 pass / 0 fail (adds zh-CN + en copy lookup).
- `apps/web` suite: 1387 pass / 0 fail (adds the code to the zh-CN coverage list and asserts the new guidance).
- `server.test.ts` "model registry persists multiple profiles…": pass; the live `run.failed` frame now carries `"errorCode":"model-credential-missing"` while still containing the original `saved API token` text.
- Reverting only the two source edits makes the new classifier cases and the live-stream assertion fail (`semantic-error`), confirming the tests catch the old behaviour.

Full `services/api` run: 2483 tests, 2472 pass, 2 skipped, 9 fail. The 9 are unrelated and pre-existing in this host: 6 need `bwrap`/specialist transports that are not installed, 2 subagent event-order cases fail identically on a clean base checkout, and 1 evolve journey times out on the base commit too.

## Risk

Low: additive union member and one new i18n key per surface. Unknown or future codes still fall back to the existing generic title and localized body; the provider's original text is untouched.

Closes #1292

```
pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop test && pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/web test && cd services/api && node --import tsx --test src/run-failure.test.ts
```

1297.author: yuanzhou75
1297.body:
Idea Tree has no release-only real-model journeys for multi-round assessment and recovery. This adds two L5 browser/API journeys and fixes the two engine defects that stopped them from completing.

## The defects this also fixes

**1. A raw control character in the model's JSON.** `parse_json()` rejected a raw control character inside a JSON string, so a model that wrote an unescaped newline into a multi-line field ended the stage. A stage gets exactly one correction, so the whole research was settled as `interrupted`:

```
research settled as "interrupted": propagate: invalid model result after one correction:
Invalid control character at: line 1 column 1204 (char 1203)
```

Measured on a `standard` run: round 3 of 3, phase `propagate`, 15 nodes at depth 3, **585,428 tokens already spent**, all three candidates' design, three assessments and aggregate complete — it failed on candidate node 2's second propagation.

`parse_json()` now calls `json.loads(body, strict=False)`, which keeps that character as text. Truncated or non-JSON answers still raise, and a regression test pins both halves: the raw newline is read as text, and `{"text": ` still raises.

**2. A proposal one refinement past `maxDepth`.** `proposal_path()` raised `Proposal exceeds maxDepth`, and the one correction was not enough because nothing told the model how many refinement steps the ceiling still allowed — at depth 3 under `standard` the allowance is zero:

```
research settled as "interrupted": ideate: invalid model result after one correction: Proposal exceeds maxDepth
```

`maxDepth` is documented in the ideate prompt as "a safety ceiling", so the path is now trimmed to what fits — `path[:max(depth - parent['depth'] - 1, 0)]` — and the parent and candidate legality checks are unchanged; a proposal that fits keeps every step. When the parent already sits at `maxDepth - 1` the allowance is zero, so no direction node fits: the candidate attaches directly under that parent and **records the direction it could not place** as `trimmedDirection` rather than discarding it. Tests pin all three shapes.

## What the journeys add

Both use standard exploration (three rounds of three candidates) and a two-hour per-case safety timeout.

## What the current head changes

- **Polls survive a transient read failure.** The reads inside the waits cover 20–30 minutes of a paid run, so passing every read through `RunPollRecovery` lets three 502/503/504/ECONNRESET/timeout failures be retried instead of ending the case; writes (create, pause, continue) are never replayed.
- **`blocked` is a wait, not a terminal state.** `runs/index.ts` resumes the same run once a card is decided, so a `blocked` run only fails the step when a pending permission or configuration card actually needs a person; otherwise the step keeps polling.
- **A settled run names the card it is waiting on.** When a run reports a terminal status without a research, the step reads `GET /api/permission-requests?sessionId=` and `GET /api/sessions/:id/configuration-requests`, filters them to the states that still wait, and fails with those summaries or capability ids. A failed card read is reported in that message rather than dropped as "no pending card". `expect.poll` retries any non-matching value, so the terminal case throws instead of returning a value the matcher would retry.
- **The Session allows the governed tools a standard research needs.** A three-round standard research prepares its inputs with governed tools, and the default approval mode parks the run as `blocked` on the first one — measured twice, both cases, ~10 minutes each, no research created. The Session is created with `approvalMode: "always_allow"`; approval surfaces have their own journeys (`journey-governed-download-approval`, `journey-sandbox-network-consent`).
- **The exploration override is session-scoped, not deployment-wide.** The previous revision rewrote `/api/settings/idea-tree` and restored it in `finally`, so a killed worker could leave a shared stack on the wrong template, and a failed restore replaced the real failure. The journey makes one write, `PATCH /api/sessions/:id` with `ideaTreeOverride`, which dies with the Session. It sets exactly two of the five fields the override accepts (`templateId`, `explorationIntensity`, out of `templateId`/`explorationIntensity`/`maxDepth`/`maxNodes`/`scoreDirection`); nothing outside that set (`designSystemPrompt` and the other system-level fields) is written anywhere, so both cases stay session-local. The tag moves from `@isolation:global` to `@isolation:session`. `research.settings` is asserted against `{ templateId, explorationIntensity: "standard" }`.
- **The waits are ordered under the case budget instead of summing past it.** The previous revision summed 300s + 1800s + 6600s = 8700s of polls inside a 7200s case timeout, so a hang reported as a case timeout with no step name. Now 600s to create + 120s running + 480s paused + 300s resumed + 4800s terminal = 6300s, leaving ~900s for the composer command, the reload and cleanup.
- **The creation budget is sized from a measured attempt.** A run of the recovery prompt spent more than 300s preparing its inputs — still on turn 5, that turn carrying 142K input tokens — before it could call `create_idea_research`, while another run of the same prompt completed the whole research in 23.4m.
- **The pause only fires while the engine is running.** Sending `operation: "pause"` the instant a research appears could race a research that had already settled; the paused budget then waited on a state that could never arrive. The step waits for `running` first, and after `continue` polls until the status leaves `paused`.
- **The reload step checks the page, not only the API.** After `page.reload()` the journey asserts the user-visible Idea Tree control region is back, then reads the API; asserting only the API would pass even if the page had dropped the research.
- **A non-`completed` settlement names its reason.** Every wait stops on any terminal status (`completed`, `paused`, `ended`, `interrupted`) and the assertion reports `research.reason`.
- **`.ci/README.md` real case counts** updated for the two new identities: L5 64 → 66.

## Validation

| Layer | Command | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| E2E metadata | `node test/check-e2e-meta.mjs` | 128 spec files, 0 errors |
| Collection | `npm --prefix .e2e run test:real:list` | 70 tests in 13 files; both L5 identities listed once each |

Local UT, ST and mocked E2E are **not** claimed here: they do not exercise this file, and the Windows host cannot run the suite's postinstall. UT/ST run on this PR only after it leaves draft — a draft skips them by policy (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:227,403`), so `L1` success on the draft head is not evidence that they passed.

## Real L5 execution

Recorded for this head (`dce876b0`) only. Stack built from main, WSL Ubuntu / linux-amd64 on `http://127.0.0.1:4310` (default port and repository-default data directory, not isolated), backend `legacy` (`--no-node-build --no-jiuwenswarm`), model `http://113.46.219.251:8080/v1` with `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017`, Playwright `workers: 1`. The synced tree has no `.git`, so the fixed `skills/idea-tree-team/SKILL.md` description (the #1312 fix) identifies the code that ran.

| Case | Result | Wall |
| --- | --- | --- |
| L5 Idea Tree: Multi-round water treatment research | in flight | — |
| L5 Idea Tree: Resume a materials research | in flight | — |

The previous head `88224490` carried a failing pair for reasons outside the research itself, and both are named here rather than dropped: water reached and passed steps 1-2 and failed step 3, where the reopened Session's heading did not appear within 60s on a stack holding twenty Projects; recovery failed at step 1 because no research was created inside the 600s budget, the agent-side behaviour tracked in #1311. The deep link is now retried three times before it is reported unopenable, which is a bound on that first race and not a relaxation: three failed navigations still fail the case.

## Known coverage gaps

1. **A live-model empty or truncated answer can still settle a research as `interrupted`.** That is the engine's designed behaviour (`research.py:318-319`); the case reports the reason rather than retrying it.
2. **Approval and configuration interactions are not covered here.** The Session runs with `always_allow`, so an approval card cannot appear; those surfaces are covered by their own journeys.
3. **Cost is not recorded.** The case's `finally` calls `cleanupJourney`, which deletes the Project and with it the research record, and no usage rows survive that window — a passing run's token ledger is not recoverable, so no cost figure is quoted.
4. **No `maxTokens` cap is set.** A standard research legitimately needs three rounds of three candidates with three assessors each; a cap low enough to bound cost would stop the run before the multi-round assertion.
5. **Backend.** The runs use `legacy`; the daily profile defaults to `jiuwenswarm`. Whether `jiuwenswarm` passes is not covered.

## Release

Release category: release:internal
User impact: two engine fixes users can see — a research that used to settle `interrupted` mid-run (a raw control character in the model's JSON, or a proposal one refinement past `maxDepth`) now completes, and the direction a ceiling trim cannot place is kept on the candidate. The rest of the diff is test coverage.
Compatibility and migration: none.

1298.author: agent-ci-infra-bot[bot]
1298.body:
While the workspace panel is open it takes the task sidebar's place (`App.tsx:1377`), but `clampPanelWidth` still subtracted a 360px sidebar that is not rendered. The ceiling fell below the panel's own default on ordinary widths, so the panel opened narrower than 720px and the splitter could not move; 360 matched no current layout either.

## Changes
- `panel-width.ts`: reserve the columns that are really there — the 64px rail plus the 512px conversation floor — and the task column (now the real 296px) only while it is rendered. `clampPanelWidth` takes a `PanelShell { panelOpen, sidebarOpen }`, and `panelCeiling` exposes the arithmetic.
- `use-panel-width.ts` / `App.tsx`: thread `workspaceOpen` and `sidebarOpen` into the hook. `nudge` no longer writes a viewport-clamped width to `PANEL_WIDTH_STORAGE_KEY`: a press the window cannot show is a no-op, otherwise only the panel's own bounds are folded in, so a remembered 720/1100 survives and renders again after widening the window.
- `tests/panel-width.test.ts`: regression tests for both shell states at one viewport (panel open → 924 at 1500; sidebar on screen → 628), a guard that 64/296 match `tokens.css`, and a mounted-hook case covering the persisted width after a nudge.

## Validation
- `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop test` → 1402 pass / 0 fail.
- `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop typecheck` and `tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit` → clean.
- Revert-check: on the pre-fix arithmetic and nudge the new assertions fail (628!==924, 628!==720, 728!==1024, 480!==704, 628!==924); all pass after the fix.
- Ceiling measured by the tests: 1500x950 628 → 924 px; 1800x950 928 → 1100 px (cap only).

## Remaining risk
Browser E2E was not run: the `.e2e` Playwright environment is not provisioned in this workspace. The conversation column is 6px narrower than the 512px floor because `.workspace-panel` keeps its 6px left margin — unchanged here and immaterial visually.

Closes #1296

### Tests

```
pnpm --filter "@sciencediscovery/desktop..." build && pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop test && pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop typecheck
```
